tune.name: Largo al factotum: Figaro qua, Figaro là

colours.name: sand
colours.means: Seville streets and town square (shared with Carmen)

colours.name: bulb
colours.means: Figaro, clean linen and razor glint

acts.name: I PERSONAGGI
acts.happens: Overture roll call: dark stage spotlights and zooms in on each of the four characters one by one with their signature sound and badge.
acts.set: Dark stage in deep night indigo.
acts.characters: Almaviva (gold), Rosina (rose), Bartolo (fusty brown), Figaro (clean white).
acts.actions: Close-up zooms on each character in turn: Almaviva with guitar strum (ALMAVIVA : THE LOVER 🎸), Rosina with soprano flutter (ROSINA : THE WARD), Bartolo with grumpy bass thud (BARTOLO : THE GUARDIAN), Figaro with razor snip rhythm (FIGARO : THE BARBER ✂️); then camera pulls wide as the street settles for dawn.
acts.music: Signature character motifs and acoustic Spanish guitar strums.
acts.emotion: Setting the comedic stage and meeting the players.

acts.name: ECCO RIDENTE
acts.happens: Count Almaviva serenades Rosina's locked balcony at dawn.
acts.set: Dark street at dawn in deep blue-black night, with one warm gold window glowing high at the top.
acts.characters: Almaviva in gold alone at the bottom; Rosina a dim rose dot behind the top window.
acts.actions: Almaviva strums upward arpeggios that radiate towards the window; Rosina's shutter opens and brightens; she drops a secret note before the window shuts.
acts.music: Lyrical serenade on tenor voice with guitar-like arp plucks; soft morning bass pulse.
acts.emotion: A lone lover looking up into the dark; sweet, gentle comedy.

versions.label: serenade under the shutter
versions.idea: Almaviva stands below, plucking guitar arpeggios that radiate small upward arcs; the window at [4, 1] flickers awake in gold, revealing Rosina.

versions.label: drifting dawn wash
versions.idea: Street starts in pure indigo; with each phrase of the song, dawn light spreads from bottom to top until the window opens.

versions.label: hired musicians crowd
versions.idea: A little trio of dots accompanies Almaviva, plucking around him, then scurrying off when Bartolo stirs.

acts.name: LARGO AL FACTOTUM
acts.happens: Figaro bursts onto the scene, bragging that everyone in town demands his services. He snakes across the market, bumping into townspeople with rapid-fire service pitches.
acts.set: Seville town square in broad daylight; townspeople stand dotted across the entire screen like market stalls and shoppers.
acts.characters: Figaro in clean linen white, owning the bustling square.
acts.actions: Figaro enters solo in the center; as the crowd gathers dotted across the entire screen, Figaro snakes like the classic Nokia Snake game through the pedestrian lanes at lightning speed, leaving a glowing speed blur trail behind him; he bumps into customers in turn to deliver his services (✂️ FIGARO !, 🦱 FIGARO !, 🧪 FIGARO !, 💌 FIGARO !); finally zips back dead centre as the whole crowd shouts FIGARO ! and he delivers his comic wink (😉 SON QUA !).
acts.music: Galloping 6/8 Rossini tempo; tenor swagger jumping into lightning-fast 16th-note arp patter.
acts.emotion: Relentless momentum and ego; the thrill of someone completely in control of the room.
acts.wink: Crowd flashes FIGARO! as Figaro freezes dead centre.

versions.label: the nokia snake crowd
versions.idea: Townspeople dotted across the entire screen; Figaro slithers between them leaving a speed blur trail, bumping into customers with his badges (barber, wigmaker, doctor, postman), then freezes dead centre for the wink.

versions.label: the four-corner dash
versions.idea: Figaro zips to all four corners of the grid in rapid succession while the stage freezes; at the climax, 3 corner dots simultaneously shout FIGARO! and he freezes dead centre (SON QUA!).

versions.label: bouncing pinball
versions.idea: Figaro bounces off the grid borders like a billiard ball on every 6/8 beat, stopping dead in the centre on the wink.

acts.name: UNA VOCE POCO FA
acts.happens: Rosina writes her secret love letter while Bartolo guards the parlour. Figaro arrives as the courier to deliver the note to Lindoro waiting in the street.
acts.set: Bartolo's parlour. Bartolo guards on the left [2, 4]; Rosina is at her writing desk on the right [6, 4]; Lindoro waits below in the street [4, 7].
acts.characters: Rosina in rose silk, Bartolo in fusty brown, Figaro in white linen, Lindoro in gold.
acts.actions: Rosina sings her sweet cantabile melody; she shows the secret letter (💌 A LOVE LETTER / 💌 IL BIGLIETTO); Figaro arrives as the courier (💌 POSTMAN! / 💌 POSTINO!); Rosina hands him the note (💌 FOR LINDORO! / 💌 PER LINDORO!); Figaro agrees (🤫 LEAVE IT TO ME! / 🤫 LASCIA FARE!) and darts down to the street where Lindoro catches it with a joyful guitar strum; Bartolo stalks over suspicious (🧐 WHO WAS THAT?! / 🧐 CHI ERA?!); Rosina plays innocent (😇 NOBODY! / 😇 NESSUNO!); Rosina winks at the audience (😉 …BUT! / 😉 …MA!).
acts.music: Sweet soprano cantabile melody over pizzicato accompaniment, bursting into playful coloratura trills and guitar strum.
acts.emotion: Apparent innocence hiding pure scheming; outsmarting the guardian right under his nose.

versions.label: the courier handoff
versions.idea: Rosina writes her secret note; Figaro slips into the room to take it; Figaro runs it down to Lindoro waiting in the street; Bartolo stalks over suspicious; Rosina plays innocent; winks …BUT! when he turns away.

acts.name: IL SOLDATO
acts.happens: Bartolo's soldier guard is asleep and snoring in the parlour corridor. Almaviva tiptoes past to rescue Rosina, but accidental clatter wakes the guard.
acts.set: Bartolo's parlour corridor; guard asleep dead centre [4, 4].
acts.characters: Guard in soldier green [4, 4], Almaviva in gold [1, 4], Rosina waiting on the right [7, 4].
acts.actions: Guard snores asleep with deep saw-wave rumbles (💤 SNORE... / 💤 RONF...); Almaviva tiptoes in with staccato pizzicato steps; guard lets out a loud snort (💤 ZZZ!) and Almaviva freezes; Almaviva slips around the guard; sudden kick/snare clatter; guard snaps awake shouting (🛑 STOP! / 🛑 ALTO!); Almaviva grabs Rosina and runs (🏃 RUN! / 🏃 VIA!).
acts.music: Deep comical snoring drone, stealthy pizzicato tiptoe runs, sudden cymbal/drum crash, and panicked allegro sprint.
acts.emotion: Classic slapstick farce: holding your breath, sudden noise, and thrilling escape.

versions.label: the sleeping guard tiptoe
versions.idea: Guard snores asleep in the corridor; lover tiptoes past; guard snorts; freeze; clatter wakes him; STOP!; lovers dash.

acts.name: LA TEMPESTA
acts.happens: A midnight storm rages as Figaro and Almaviva sneak a ladder up to Rosina's balcony.
acts.set: Midnight sky in dark indigo; violent full-grid lightning strobes.
acts.characters: Figaro (white) and Almaviva (gold) below; Rosina (rose) above at the window.
acts.actions: Chromatic rain runs sweep the grid; lightning flashes; a column of cells lights 1-by-1 upward like a ladder (🪜 THE LADDER! / 🪜 LA SCALA!); the lovers unite and run (🏃 RUN! / 🏃 VIA!).
acts.music: Rossini thunderstorm: rapid piccolo-like arp chromatic descents, deep bass drum thunder rumbles, silence between thunderclaps.
acts.emotion: Danger and urgency, rushing against the clock.

versions.label: the lightning ladder
versions.idea: Chromatic rain runs on the arp voice; sudden full-grid white lightning strobes; ladder lights 1-by-1 upward; lovers unite and flee.

acts.name: FELICITÀ
acts.happens: In the cathedral, Almaviva and Rosina are married at the altar. Bartolo accepts defeat, the couple share a tender altar close-up with a glowing heart emoji, and a warm wave of love turns the whole congregation pink.
acts.set: Cathedral interior: central aisle flanked by pews of wedding guests.
acts.characters: Groom (Almaviva in gold) and Bride (Rosina in rose) at the altar [3,2] and [5,2]; Figaro (white) presiding at [4,1]; Bartolo (fusty brown) at the church doors [4,8].
acts.actions: Bartolo rushes into church doors (STOP!); sees bride (💍 MARRIED! / 💍 SPOSI!); shrugs defeat (🤷 OH WELL! / 🤷 PAZIENZA!); close-up zoom on couple at altar with glowing heart emoji (❤️) and lyrical love duet crescendo; camera pulls wide as concentric pink waves radiate from the altar, turning all wedding guests throughout the cathedral pink; triumphant tutti Rossini wedding cadence (🎉 HAPPINESS! / 🎉 FELICITÀ!).
acts.music: Cathedral acoustics; sparkling church bell arpeggios on arp; full-throated soprano and tenor duet; triumphant Rossini wedding cadence.
acts.emotion: Unadulterated celebration; love wins, the fixer gets paid, everyone is happy.

versions.label: the altar zoom and pink love wave
versions.idea: Cathedral pews; Bartolo shrugs OH WELL!; close-up zoom on altar couple with heart emoji and love duet crescendo; concentric pink waves turn the whole congregation pink.

acts.chosen: the altar zoom and pink love wave
